text:
oliver: dropping a new proposal for the regression-diff timeline scrubber in the eval run UI. goal: help reviewers jump to first/next regression and reduce scroll hunting. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/regression-scrubber-v1.png

zoe: nice! short explain?

oliver: scrubber sits above diffs, shows a small timeline with colored ticks (green=pass, yellow=changed, red=regression). left/right arrows jump to prev/next regression. hover previews snippet.

rachel: usability q: if there are tons of regressions, will ticks be too dense? need clustering and zoom.

oliver: plan: cluster ticks at high density with a count tooltip. click a cluster to expand a mini-list or zoom in. also keyboard: `,` and `.` to go prev/next regression.

sam: a11y: timeline needs accessible name and visible focus target on each tick. for screenreaders, when you move to a tick announce "Regression at test X, 2 diffs". consider `role=\"slider\"`? not really a value. better use a `list` of buttons inside `role=tablist`?

oliver: agree not slider. we'll render ticks as buttons in a `nav[aria-label=\"Regression timeline\"]` with `aria-pressed` for active tick. when activated, set focus to the diff header and populate an `aria-live` region: "Showing diff for <test name>, regression count 2".

zoe: microcopy: arrows should show tooltips "Next regression (R)" since we have keyboard shortcuts. also show a tiny legend: red=regression, yellow=changed, grey=unchanged.

rachel: visual contrast: aria_bot flagged timeline grey ticks too light on light background. raise opacity or add subtle border.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: timeline small targets must be >=44px touch target; cluster mode should expand targets. contrast for grey #cfcfcf on #ffffff is 2.2:1. Recommend #b3b3b3 or outline on hover/focus.

sam: another: when reviewer approves via sticky bar, scrubber should update (remove red ticks or mark as approved) and toast: "Approved 1 regression. Undo" with `role=status`. undo should revert scrubber state.

oliver: yes. also add an option to filter timeline by tag (e.g., show only regressions or only failures). persistent filter state per user.

zoe: performance: lazy-render ticks only for viewport + cluster summary for rest. dev note: use canvas for dense timeline or SVG if we need interactions on ticks.

rachel: accessibility follow-up: ensure keyboard focus order includes scrubber before diffs so it becomes discoverable. maybe have a skip link: "Skip to first regression" for quick nav.

oliver: action items: (oliver) update mock with cluster expand + legend + darker greys (2211110012), (sam) prototype aria-live messaging and keyboard hooks, (zoe) write tooltip copy and shortcut hint, (rachel) test focus order and propose skip-link placement.

zoe: love it. small UX nit: on hover preview show truncated output with `...` and a tiny "open in full diff" affordance. keep hover content light.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: recommended focus ring 3px on tick buttons and ensure cluster expand is announced with `aria-expanded`.

oliver: thanks all, I'll push updated PNG and a short HTML demo for screenreader testing. :thumbsup:
